title: WSS guide: pushState gap detection is wrong — client cannot detect when server skipped replay
description: The pushState catch-up section says the client can detect when the server did not replay missed changes because 'it returns a StateChange with a different pushState without replaying missed changes'. The client has no reliable way to know whether the server replayed history or just started fresh — both look like a normal StateChange frame. RFC 8887 says servers that cannot honor a pushState simply skip replay with no explicit signal. The correct guidance is to issue a proactive /changes sweep on reconnect for critical types regardless, treating the pushState mechanism as an optimization that may or may not have replayed history.
